summary: Community-generated API reference for go-playground/validator v10.30.4, extracted from the pinned upstream commit with Sourcey 3.6.5 (godoc snapshot -> static site, 29 pages), verified by a governed runx validation run that is signed in CI by a published Ed25519 identity, and published on a documentation domain that predates this work (https://validator-community-docs.readthedocs.io). Revision 3 binds the CI-issued receipt, restores the committed snapshot bytes to the digest this packet claims, and retires the earlier local-development receipt.

observations.label: revision 1 (auto-review)
observations.note: Auto-review blocked payment because public_url lived on a personal <handle>.github.io namespace; re-hosted at a registered project domain, evidence URLs updated to match

observations.label: revision 2 (human review)
observations.note: Review found the registered domain was created for the submission, so it was a placeholder host rather than a home an ecosystem user would trust. The docs now publish on readthedocs.io, a documentation domain that existed before this work, built from the same public repository and serving the same bytes.

observations.label: revision 3 (receipt quality and byte-exactness)
observations.note: Two defects fixed. First, the bound receipt had been issued by a local development runtime (issuer type local, kid runtime-skeleton), which a reviewer cannot verify without accepting development signatures; it is replaced by a receipt issued inside CI with issuer type ci and a published public key, verified with signature mode production. Second, the committed snapshot had been re-serialized after the packet recorded its digest, so the packet's digest did not match the published bytes; the byte-exact copy is committed again and the governed run now reports snapshot_matches=true. The earlier receipt files remain in git history and are labelled as superseded in receipts/README.md.
